WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_REFERENCE') as order_ref,
    AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_REFERENCE')
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as global_average
  FROM order_averages
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT
    order_ref,
    avg_fillcount,
    avg_fillcount - (SELECT global_average FROM global_avg) as margin_over_global
  FROM order_averages
  WHERE avg_fillcount > (SELECT global_average FROM global_avg)
),
second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as second_average
  FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT
    order_ref,
    avg_fillcount,
    margin_over_global,
    avg_fillcount - (SELECT second_average FROM second_benchmark) as margin_over_second
  FROM first_filter
  WHERE avg_fillcount > (SELECT second_average FROM second_benchmark)
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_per_order_fill_size,
  AVG(margin_over_global) as avg_margin_over_first_benchmark,
  AVG(margin_over_second) as avg_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM second_filter;
